item.title: Version 1.5.81
item.description:
✨ v1.5.81 Update

  • Fix It can switch an action from AppleScript to Shell Script when the repair needs a different interpreter. It saves the new action type and the repaired script together.
  • The floating panel stays open while Fix It is working, even when you click or scroll in another app.
  • Switching Settings tabs keeps the window size fixed. The sidebar opens at full width, and Actions scrolls without visible scrollbars.
  • Press ⌘1–⌘4 in Settings to switch between General, Actions, Inline AI, and License. Hold ⌘ to see the shortcuts in the sidebar.
